nodes.description: address constant to = 0x4135cfC4559df9145479010B7E21C7449fC9CfdE, first withdrawal recipient
address constant to1 = 0xDfd67f52D72e5ACFb42e53dB30E633F0Da8bE130, second withdrawal recipient
uint256 public price = 0.05 ether, mint price used in fallback require
uint256 public maxSupply = 2100, cap checked in fallback
uint256 public totalSupply, minted counter mutated in fallback and set_total_supply
modifier own: require(msg.sender == hardcoded owner), access control guard
fallback() external payable: accepts ETH, computes amount from msg.value, updates totalSupply and emits Minted
set_price(uint256 newprice) public own, privileged price update
set_total_supply(uint256 val) public own, privileged supply overwrite
withdraw() public own, sends contract balance to to and to1 via transfer
msg.sender: caller identity used for the owner check and for the Minted event
totalSupply += amount, arithmetic mutation of supply inside fallback
payable(to).transfer(address(this).balance / 6), external ETH transfer
payable(to1).transfer(address(this).balance), external ETH transfer of remaining balance
price = newprice, privileged write to price state variable
totalSupply = val, privileged overwrite of supply state variable
require(msg.sender == 0x5e0a744f101F82E0a661477E36783C6c22d3D791), hardcoded-address access control check
uint256 newprice parameter of set_price
uint256 val parameter of set_total_supply
uint256 amount local variable in fallback derived from msg.value branches

edges.reason: own modifier gates execution of set_price
own modifier gates execution of set_total_supply
own modifier gates execution of withdraw
own modifier body performs the hardcoded owner require check
fallback conditionally executes the totalSupply increment
fallback assigns the amount local variable from the msg.value branch ladder
set_price executes the price assignment
set_total_supply executes the totalSupply assignment
withdraw performs the first external transfer
withdraw performs the second external transfer
amount local variable is added into totalSupply
totalSupply is read before being incremented
incremented value is written back into totalSupply
newprice parameter flows into the price assignment
val parameter flows into the totalSupply assignment
price assignment writes the price state variable
totalSupply assignment writes the totalSupply state variable
msg.sender is compared against the hardcoded owner address
msg.sender is emitted as the minter address in the Minted event
price is read in the fallback msg.value >= price requirement
maxSupply is read in the fallback totalSupply < maxSupply requirement
first transfer sends funds to the to address
second transfer sends funds to the to1 address
external ETH transfer from withdraw can hand control to the recipient
external ETH transfer from withdraw can hand control to the recipient
